categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai HIUV New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of special polymer films, focusing on photovoltaic (PV) encapsulation films used in solar modules. The company also develops new high-quality membrane materials for automotive applications, including smart glass dimming films, lightweight eco-friendly synthetic leather, and glass encapsulation films. Its business segments include PV encapsulation materials and emerging automotive new materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary polymer formulations, self-designed production equipment, and integrated processing technologies. Key technologies include EVA and POE encapsulation films with anti-PID, anti-hydrolysis, and multi-layer co-extrusion capabilities, as well as innovative products like zero-migration light conversion films and instant liquid crystal dimming films. Production follows a make-to-order model with advanced automation and quality control systems to ensure product stability and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HIUV serves leading photovoltaic module manufacturers and automotive OEMs, particularly in the new energy vehicle sector. Its PV films are critical components for solar module encapsulation, targeting markets requiring high efficiency and durability. The automotive segment focuses on smart glass and interior materials for electric vehicles and high-end applications. The company’s customers are mainly top-tier industry players with stable, long-term procurement relationships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with manufacturing and sales concentrated in Shanghai and other domestic locations. It has established subsidiaries and production facilities in multiple Chinese cities and overseas subsidiaries in Singapore, Vietnam, and Australia to support international market penetration and local production. Overseas sales and operations contribute a smaller portion of revenue but are strategically important for global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: HIUV operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic and automotive supply chains, producing specialized polymer films that serve as key materials for downstream module manufacturers and automotive component suppliers. It procures raw materials like EVA and POE resins upstream and delivers finished encapsulation films and membrane products downstream to module assemblers and automotive tier-1 suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in advanced polymer formulations, new encapsulation technologies for emerging PV cell types (TOPCon, HJT, perovskite), and innovative automotive membrane materials such as instant liquid crystal dimming films and lightweight eco-friendly synthetic leather. It emphasizes rapid product iteration, technology leadership, and cross-industry application expansion. Future R&D also targets recycling technologies and AI-enabled smart materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of specialized polymer films and related materials to photovoltaic module manufacturers and automotive OEMs or their suppliers. The company follows a make-to-order production and direct sales model, with contracts and framework agreements with key customers. It also earns income from licensing proprietary technologies and may receive government subsidies related to innovation and environmental initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HIUV is positioned as a technology-leading supplier in the Chinese and global photovoltaic encapsulation film market, ranking among the top suppliers with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. It competes with other domestic and international polymer film manufacturers but differentiates through innovation, product quality, and close customer collaboration. In automotive new materials, it is an emerging innovator with first-mover advantages in smart dimming films and eco-friendly synthetic leather.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.59 billion, a 46.8% decline from the previous year, primarily due to reduced sales volume and pricing pressure in the PV film market. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -558 million, reflecting industry downturns and increased R&D and impairment expenses. Total assets decreased by 40.1% to RMB 3.22 billion, with ongoing investments in new product development and international expansion. The company maintains a strong R&D intensity of around 4.55% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HIUV emphasizes its proprietary polymer formulations, rapid innovation cycle, and integrated production capabilities to deliver high-performance encapsulation films that enhance solar module efficiency and durability. Its automotive materials offer unique features such as instant dimming, lightweight, and low VOC emissions, addressing emerging market needs for energy efficiency and environmental sustainability. The company’s strong customer relationships and technical support further differentiate it as a trusted partner in high-end polymer film solutions.
